task_description: Write Python function place_circles(n) returning list of (x,y,r) tuples. Pack n circles in unit square maximizing minimum radius. Baseline hex grid scores 0.0833. Use simulated annealing, greedy optimization, or iterative refinement to beat baseline.

history.motivation: I will use a simulated annealing approach combined with a greedy initialization to explore the configuration space and maximize the minimum radius.

I will use an iterative refinement approach based on simulated annealing. The state space will be defined by the radii of $N$ circles, and the objective function will be to maximize the minimum radius

I will use Simulated Annealing (SA) to optimize the radii of $N$ circles within the unit square. The objective function will maximize the minimum radius, subject to non-overlap and boundary constraint
